subject.title: fix(codex): bound Codex CLI auth file read

question: Does the Codex CLI auth-file contract permit treating an auth file above 1 MiB as unreadable for fallback cache-key computation while the remaining asynchronous auth-file reader retains its current behavior?
rationale: The patch changes an auth-provider edge case and repository policy requires direct sibling Codex source inspection before a Codex-related verdict; that inspection could not be completed here.

options.title: Confirm bounded cache-key scope
options.body: Verify the Codex CLI contract and merge this focused cache-key hardening if undefined remains the supported cache behavior for oversized files.

options.title: Bound every auth-file reader coherently
options.body: If the asynchronous reader can reach the same untrusted file in production, extend the work with a contract-preserving bounded-read design and matching tests.
